newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE wheat up as sterling goes down.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE wheat up as sterling goes down.

text.p: LIFFE wheat ended higher after sterling's fall against the mark, traders said.
Active November was last traded 0.85 stg higher at 84.20 stg on volume of 188 lots of a total 345 on wheat.
Barley was mostly higher with active March 1998 last traded 0.75 stg higher at 83.25 stg on volume of 25 of a total 54 lots.
The market fluctuated in inverse relation to sterling's moves during the day, ending near highs as the UK currency extended its slide to below 2.98 marks in afternoon European trading, traders said.
Some short covering by shippers and merchants was seen, one trader noted. But shipper activity represented more an attempt to assess the market than the need to cover any real business, he felt.
Sterling's volatility and a desire to wait for more definite crop information again kept physical markets subdued, brokers said.
